request:
镜头 s09：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持中景，轻微晃动。宋工把铁盒举到波爷面前，认真地解释；波爷探身过来，皱着眉打量这只盒子。环境声：机房嗡鸣、远处的空调声。
情绪：earnest, curious, sceptical
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium two-shot, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings
景深与虚实：Moderate depth of field: both faces and the box sharp, the server hall behind the glass soft.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Handheld documentary two-shot at night in the lab: Song holds up the dented tin box with its antenna toward Boye, a 44-year-old man in black-framed glasses and a navy quilted jacket, who leans in sceptically over the workbench; desk lamp light, the glass wall with the red lens behind them. Blocking lock: Song stands at frame left holding the tin box up at chest height, Boye leans in from frame right over the workbench; the glass wall and the red lens glow in the background centre.
Picture 2: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
Picture 3: Boye at 44 (Song's colleague, network protocol engineer, in the 2050s) (character reference; role: Song's colleague). A 44-year-old Chinese man, network protocol engineer: short black hair with the first grey streaks, dark stubble, intact black-framed glasses, a broad nose and a stubborn mouth. Dark navy quilted work jacket over a brown knitted vest.
Picture 4: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker) (prop reference; role: prop reference). A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.
Picture 5: the 550 project laboratory at night (2050s) (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the quantum-computer laboratory of a national research institute at night in the 2050s: a long cluttered engineer's workbench with a soldering station, oscilloscopes, coils of wire, circuit boards and notebooks under a desk lamp; behind a large glass wall, a cold clean server hall with rows of tall black cabinets and, on the central black cabinet, a single round red-glowing camera lens exactly like the terminal in the reference image. Fluorescent tubes. Empty of people.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) — 宋工（三十出头男性的声音，温和、带笑意）: 每台机器，自己带一把钥匙，自己证明自己是谁。
现场环境声：server hall hum, air conditioning, the faint tick of the tin box
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 10.0s, 24fps, observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium two-shot, shoulder-mounted handheld camera with small late reframings, drifting very slowly from a medium two-shot to a slightly tighter medium two-shot as the operator catches up with the lean-in; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Song stands at frame left behind the workbench, the dented tin box held up at chest height in both hands; Boye at frame right, bent forward over the bench, one forearm resting on it; the glass wall and the red lens glow in the background centre; the desk lamp pools warm light across the bench in the foreground. Start: Song lifts the tin box a little higher and turns its antenna toward Boye, his other hand flat under the box, and begins to speak with a small smile, glasses catching the lamp. Middle: he tips the box slowly left and right so the lid catches the light, his fingers tapping once on the dented corner to point it out, while the handheld frame sags and re-frames to keep both faces in; Boye leans further in across the bench, brows drawing together, head tilting to look at the antenna and then at Song, one hand scratching at his stubbled jaw, his mouth tightening into a sceptical line. End: Song settles the box steady at chest height, still talking, eyes on Boye's face; Boye pulls back a few centimetres with a short exhale through the nose, chin lifted, gaze still fixed on the box; both hold that pose. Mood: earnest, curious, sceptical. Blur: both faces and the tin box stay sharp, the server hall behind the glass falls soft into cold grey vertical shapes, the red lens a diffuse glow. Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) says, <d>[Chinese] 每台机器，自己带一把钥匙，自己证明自己是谁。</d> Final line of this shot: end on "自己证明自己是谁", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.
